pattern_rationale: STUB FIXTURE. The system already emits HL7 v2 events. Parsing the feed needs no change on the source side and gives near-real-time visit status.

alternatives_considered.why_not: No database access is offered, and the feed already carries every event.
These are event messages that must be merged per visit, not periodic full exports.

sync.detail: Process each new message file as it lands.

field_map.transform: F -> female, M -> male, else unknown

resources.merge_rule: One Patient per MRN; the latest message wins.

field_map.transform: O -> AMB, E -> EMER, I -> IMP
finished when a discharge time exists, otherwise in-progress

resources.merge_rule: One Encounter per visit number: merge A01 and A03 for the same PV1.19, later message wins per field.

risks: Cancellation events are not handled because none exist in the sample.
human_review_points: Timestamps are assumed to be UTC.
Attending clinician (PV1.7) is not mapped in this version.
